description: Dependency updates as reviewable per-package PRs with changelogs, gated by validate.yml. Inert until the Renovate GitHub App is installed on this repository; meant to replace .github/workflows/dependency-updates.yml, which runs an unreviewable `npm update && npm audit fix` every Monday.

schedule: before 8am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: One weekly PR carries the routine minor/patch bumps
Major bumps of the database driver, auth and crypto layers wait for a human
